title: Endpoint of concatenated walks
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph on $V$. For every vertex $v$ and finite lists of neighbor-slot choices $w,w'$, following the concatenated list $w++w'$ from $v$ ends at the same vertex as first following $w$ from $v$ and then following $w'$ from that endpoint.
hypotheses_covered: $w,w'$ are finite lists of neighbor-slot choices
